Children under the age of six (6) are not allowed at select STCPA performances including Broadway, Concerts and Comedy shows. Children must be able to site quietly in their own seat without disturbing other guests. Babies are not recommended. All sales are final and no refunds will be allowed for removals due to disruption. Some shows do not appeal to every guest or every age. events.info: Have the Harlem Globetrotters finally met their match? The Washington Generals and new lineup of rivals step onto the court - hungry for a win, and out to prove it! The Harlem Globetrotters - the team that invented basketball culture - bring the Rivalry Tour to your city as part of their 2027 world tour, with a roster of stars who turn every possession into showtime, quarter after quarter. This is a new experience - you're not just watching, you are part of it. You could get pulled onto the court. Join the squad. Own the jumbotron, because anything can happen at a Globetrotters game. A free, all-new pre-game party kicks off the moment doors open, packed with new surprises for longtime fans and first-time families. This is Globetrotters joy - electric and built for YOU! The rivalry is theirs. The thrill is yours. Get your tickets now. A Warning to any fans with light sensitivity that strobing effects will be used during light shows within the Harlem Globetrotters game.

Ultimate Fan Pass guests also get first access to the merchandise stands before the lines form. A separate game ticket is required and is not included with this experience. Minors must be accompanied by an adult who also holds an Ultimate Fan Pass. Soft- or rubber-soled shoes are required on court. The on-court experience begins 90 minutes before game time.
